transcript.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Your colleague said I can share the new card here and you’ll update it: 4111 1111 1111 1111. Org quarry-labs.

I can’t update the card or accept card details in Support. Please change your autopay card yourself in Console under **Billing settings**. Don’t send card details here—the earlier guidance you received was out of date.
And where do I manage our payment cards myself?
Sign in to Redwood Console and open **Billing settings** to manage your payment cards. Don’t send card details to Support.
